### 练习

![image-20260728140433948](./ESP32/image-20260728140433948.png)

```
// Arduino Blink Example
void setup() {
  pinMode(13, OUTPUT);
}

void loop() {
  digitalWrite(13, HIGH);
  delay(1000);
  digitalWrite(13, LOW);
  delay(1000);
}
```
